contamination_risks: Prior pullback outcomes motivate replication only and cannot count toward promotion.
The pre-2016 development and confirmation targets are globally outcome-clean at freeze.
Warmup is feature-only and cannot count as target evidence.
family_contract.entry_rule: After completed SMA, RSI2, and three-session-decline qualification, rank the frozen ETF universe by lowest RSI2, deepest decline, then symbol, and enter at the next observable session open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after three or five sessions.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within five sessions.
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This existing-family replication preserves the exact authorized 32-rule grid while expanding to the prospectively authorized 19 liquid ETFs and wholly disjoint pre-2016 evidence. It does not repair or open either prior confirmation reserve.
family_contract.mechanism: Buy the deepest cost-clearing three-session pullback among broad liquid ETFs that remain above a completed long-term trend.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, protection, and reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Lowest RSI2, deepest three-session decline, then symbol.
family_contract.selection_rule: At most one new family entry per day under all portfolio risk, notional, daily-entry, and capital-contention caps.
family_contract.stop_rule: Use the exact one or one-and-a-half completed ATR14 stop below entry; invalid or missing stops are missed trades.
